> Extraction textuelle : les tableaux complexes et diagrammes vectoriels peuvent nécessiter le PDF source.

6.311 rsPageNumberInScopedAggregates
rsPageNumberInScopedAggregates is a critical error that will occur when the following conditions are
true:
An expression within a PageSection or PageHeaderFooter contains an aggregate function that has

its Scope parameter set.
That expression contains the "PageNumber" or "TotalPages" variable from the Globals global

collection.
